dog.description_text:
Meet Pixel, a gentle giant with an even bigger heart who came to us all the way from the Sunshine State. This sweet boy has a calm, loving nature and truly just wants to be near his people. Pixel is affectionate, kind, and ready to find a family who will cherish him the way he deserves. If you’re looking for a loyal companion with a heart of gold, Pixel is waiting to meet you.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.

Apply to adopt: nycsecondchancerescue.org/dog-adoption-application
